key_insight: PACEvolve provides a structured scaffold for LLM-driven evolutionary search that is explicitly progress-aware and consistency-focused, preventing historical context bias and stagnation so agents can evolve reliably over long horizons.
problem_solved: Stabilizes and scales LLM-in-the-loop evolutionary search by addressing three practical failure modes—Context Pollution (experiment history biasing future candidates), Mode Collapse (stagnation in local minima), and weak inter-agent coordination—so evolution remains effective and reproducible over long runs.
method: Progress-aware state management: encode and summarize experiment history to preserve useful signals while filtering out harmful context that would bias candidate generation.
Diversity-aware selection and exploration controls: combine novelty and fitness signals (exploration–exploitation balancing) to avoid mode collapse and maintain candidate variety.
Consistency & coordination protocol: enforce constraints and handshakes between agents/iterations to ensure coherent long-horizon plans and reliable collaboration.
impact: Makes LLM-in-the-loop evolutionary workflows more robust and reproducible, enabling practitioners to run longer, higher-quality searches without manual scaffolding. This reduces bias, avoids premature convergence, and improves practical use of LLMs as optimization operators.
visual_elements: Pipeline flowchart showing: input → progress-aware state store → LLM candidate generation → diversity-aware selection → iteration loop (highlight long-horizon feedback).
Three-failure-modes diagram: side-by-side icons for Context Pollution, Mode Collapse, Weak Collaboration with brief solution callouts.
Tradeoff chart: novelty vs. fitness over iterations illustrating how diversity-aware controls prevent collapse and maintain progress.
Timeline/heatmap showing consistent evolution across many iterations vs. a baseline that degrades due to context pollution.
paper_title: PACEvolve: Enabling Long-Horizon Progress-Aware Consistent Evolution
paper_authors: Minghao Yan, Bo Peng, Benjamin Coleman, Ziqi Chen, Zhouhang Xie
